confirmed in Claudia.

Looks like both gates
lead to "Space."

Units without the "Space" type
can't launch, so be careful.
Yeah, I know.

Right now, two gates have been
confirmed in Claudia.
Both gates lead to "Space."

Units without the "Space" type
cannot sortie.

Please keep that in mind
during Squad Setup.
Roger!

rows.notes: Segs 1-3: blank headers, read as Aria continuing. [jp] -> Squad Setup (UI).

segments.en:
Entering combat with the main force
of the Claudian Unified Forces.

We have a report from the
Infantry Squad.

Enemy resistance was light.
They've secured the interior.
That was awfully flimsy...
Is that really all they've got...?

They saw the tide was against them
and pulled out, I'd say.

Looks like we let their
main force slip away.

I figured it'd all be over
as soon as we took this place.

Where the heck
did they run off to?

The enemy is human,
just like us.

They won't slip up and show
themselves that easily.

All we can do now is hunt down
their bases one by one.

You can now dock at
Astante Fortress.

rows.notes: Segs 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 10: blank headers, read as continuations of the previous header (Aria, Kanji, Omega). [jp] rendered 'slip up and show themselves'.

infantry squad has been confirmed
inside Cecibel Base.
Proceed to infantry combat?

Yes
No

into the base.

Holding off on the
infantry assault.
